author: Shirokamii
body:
Sooo, Since im not active in avicus anymore

i tought, il just push out the Radio Avicus.

Lets try to make this a good channel!

Website :

http://radioavicus.listen2myradio.com

We do need some DJ's (allot of em)
to make this 24/7 streaming!

Soooo if you want to become a dj

Please apply by sending an email to Lucariomirc@live.nl
Including times you could dj and a small mixtape! (pref an youtube uploaded link xD)

Goodluck!

Greetings
Shirokamii


~Ex Sr.Mod
~Mczone admin
